# Pinned-fetches allowlist (projectbluefin/utah#902, Option A).
#
# One entry per line, checked by scripts/check-pinned-fetches.sh. Comments start
# with '#'. Two kinds of entry:
#
#   * A bare rule id disables that rule for the whole scan:
#       unpinned-image
#     Rule ids: mutable-url, pipe-download, unpinned-clone,
#       unpinned-image, unpinned-ostree
#
#   * Any other line suppresses one finding whose printed text (summary line OR
#     the reported source line) contains it — use the URL, image ref, or path
#     that is actually unique to the case:
#       ghcr.io/tuna-os/tacklebox:latest   # signed and re-verified upstream
#
# This gate is warn-only for one baseline cycle. Populate this file with the
# findings you have reviewed and deliberately kept (with a reason), or fix the
# fetch instead. Once the baseline is clean or fully allowlisted, flip the gate
# to --mode fail.
